coolhunting.title: The Office
coolhunting.notes: Adds three Dispatch pieces (the Oslo Architecture Triennale's ninth edition, opening 17 September under landscape architect Line Ramstad's “What if Nature Comes First?”, curated from inside a reused 19th-century church — pushing this issue's retrofit argument back a step, from ‘is this building worth keeping’ to ‘what if material and site set the brief first’; CASACOR Rio de Janeiro's 35th edition, the show's first move out of the Zona Sul and into a restored 1957–61 modernist insurance headquarters in the historic Centro — another tenant for this issue's running office-reuse argument, this time a ten-week one; and the AJ Retrofit & Reuse Awards, a fourth reuse prize outside the RIBA ladder, its office-conversion shortlist — Manchester's Campfield market halls and Wigan's 1960s Civic Centre — read as the working-budget counterpart to the Stirling, Reinvention and Stephen Lawrence shortlists already in this issue). Retires no dispatch pieces this cycle — the oldest remaining, from 3 August, is still inside the six-week window. Adds two organiser-confirmed calendar dates: CASACOR Rio de Janeiro (15 September – 8 November 2026) and the Oslo Architecture Triennale (17 September – 1 October 2026).
